file_spec.value: Digital passport-type photo, white background, good lighting, dimensions 1200 × 1200 pixels ("Fotografía digital tipo pasaporte, con fondo blanco, buena iluminación y dimensiones de 1200 × 1200 píxeles")

db_conflicts.research_value: 1200 × 1200 pixels (square digital photo — no fixed cm/mm print size published; aspect ratio is square, not the rectangular 3.5:4.5 implied by the DB value)

cross_verification.note_en: Uruguay's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (gub.uy) is the only official domain found publishing concrete tourism-visa photo specs, via the Uruguayan Embassy in Costa Rica's consular page. Uruguay does not appear to operate a unified e-visa portal; visa requirements are published per-consulate on gub.uy subpages, so specs may vary slightly by jurisdiction. No official page could be found stating a physical head-height ratio, expression, glasses, or headwear rule for this specific visa category — left unverified rather than inferred from generic third-party passport-photo vendor sites.
cross_verification.batch_note: Only uy-visa was in scope for this batch (uy-passport was not part of the assigned slug list).
